method: OLS linear regression (sklearn LinearRegression) on NYC yellow taxi Q2-2024 (Apr+May+Jun parquet, 10,777,315 raw rows). Row-group-wise read with pyarrow -> strict filter (0<trip_distance<100, 0<fare_amount<500) -> 16 features: hour, day_of_week, trip_distance, passenger_count, 6 borough_pu_* + 6 borough_do_* dummies (Bronx/Brooklyn/EWR/Manhattan/Queens/Staten Island, mapped from PULocationID/DOLocationID via taxi_zone_lookup.csv, no drop_first, Unknown/Outside-NYC zones -> all-zero baseline). train_test_split(test_size=0.2, random_state=42) -> fit on train, evaluate on held-out test.

key_intermediate_results.nan_check: no NaN in X or y after handling; passenger_count had 1,224,023 nulls raw / 1,161,287 after filter -> imputed with 1 (mode/median) to keep the spec-defined row set
key_intermediate_results.range_checks: hour in [0,23], day_of_week in [0,6], dummies in {0,1}, all-zero dummy rows: 0.33% pickup / 0.82% dropoff

robustness.note: All variants stay inside the plan sanity band (RMSE 5.0-7.5, R2 0.85-0.91); headline keeps the filter-defined row set (10.46M) as the plan expected ~10.49M rows.

sanity_band_check: RMSE 6.207 within [5.0,7.5]; R2 0.8734 within [0.85,0.91] -> no leakage signal (train RMSE 6.185 / train R2 0.8747, i.e. no overfitting)
